audience.text: Developers building .NET applications that require 3D scene construction, manipulation, and format conversion without native dependencies.

capabilities.text: Build and manage 3D scene graphs using Scene, RootNode, and Node.CreateChildNode with entities and transforms.
capabilities.title: Scene graph construction

capabilities.text: Construct primitive shapes such as Box, Cylinder, Sphere, and IFC-style profiles directly in code.
capabilities.title: Primitive geometry creation

capabilities.text: Assign shading materials like LambertMaterial, PhongMaterial, and PbrMaterial, and convert between them.
capabilities.title: Material assignment and conversion

capabilities.text: Read and write FBX, glTF, Wavefront OBJ, STL, COLLADA, U3D, 3MF, RVM, AMF, and HTML5 viewer exports.
capabilities.title: Format import and export

capabilities.text: Configure import and export behavior using dedicated options types like ObjLoadOptions and ColladaSaveOptions.
capabilities.title: Format-specific load/save options

capabilities.text: Define and manipulate per-vertex mesh data including normals, UVs, colors, and tangents via VertexDeclaration.
capabilities.title: Vertex data manipulation

limitations.text: Rendering is not implemented — Scene.Render and related APIs throw NotImplementedException.
PLY import/export works via Scene.Open/Save but the public FileFormat.PLY field and its Encode/Decode methods throw NotImplementedException.
PolygonModifier and most TriMesh helpers throw NotImplementedException — mesh post-processing utilities are not functional.
NURBS evaluation and surface-to-mesh conversion throw NotImplementedException despite data construction support.
3MF build-instruction metadata and RVM attribute loading are not implemented despite core geometry support.
License and Metered APIs exist for API compatibility but are not applicable to this open-source edition.

problems_solved.text: Enables programmatic creation and conversion of 3D scenes using pure managed code with no native dependencies.
Supports round-trip interchange with widely used 3D formats including FBX, glTF, OBJ, STL, COLLADA, and U3D.
Provides a consistent API surface compatible with Aspose.3D Enterprise Edition for migration and feature parity.

product_summary.text: Aspose.3D FOSS for .NET is a free, open-source, MIT-licensed .NET library for building, traversing, and converting 3D scenes without external dependencies.

uncertainties: The exact set of supported IFC profiles beyond those named in the README is not confirmed by facts.
Whether PLY round-tripping works for all vertex element types is not explicitly verified beyond general support.
The behavior of Scene.Open when multiple readers could match a format is not described beyond the unknown.xyz example.

workflows.name: Scene construction from primitives
workflows.text: Create a new Scene, add primitive entities like Box, assign materials, and save to FBX.

workflows.name: Format conversion
workflows.text: Load an existing scene from glTF and save it as OBJ using Scene.FromFile and Scene.Save.

workflows.name: Material conversion
workflows.text: Convert a Lambert material to a PBR material using PbrMaterial.FromMaterial.

workflows.name: Customized import and export
workflows.text: Load OBJ with coordinate system flipping and normal normalization, then export to STL.

workflows.name: Stream-based export
workflows.text: Save a scene to COLLADA format through a MemoryStream using Scene.Save with options.

workflows.name: Error handling for unrecognized formats
workflows.text: Catch ArgumentException when opening a file with an unsupported extension.
